items.title: 7.5 Khinche hue taar par stationary waves (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.5 with Fig. 7.7 and Example 7.3 (PDF 147-150); equation (7.4) is printed twice.

blocks.text: Lambai l ki ek string (taar) lein jis ke dono sire clamp (jakar) kar ke use khincha rakha gaya hai, aur string mein tension (khinchao) F hai.
(a) String ko beech se chhedna

Agar string ko beech (middle point) se chheda jaye to is point se do transverse waves nikalti hain: ek baen sire ki taraf aur doosri daen sire ki taraf jati hai. Jab yeh waves dono jakre hue siron tak pohanchti hain to reflect ho kar (palat kar) wapas aati hain aur stationary waves ban jati hain. Dono sire jakre hue hain, is liye wahan koi harkat nahi hoti; yani dono siron par nodes bante hain aur beech mein ek antinode, jaisa Fig. 7.7(a) mein hai. Dekhne mein string ek loop mein vibrate karti lagti hai. Do lagataar nodes ka faasla aadhi wavelength hota hai, is liye is mode mein string ki lambai l yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Do deewaron ke darmiyan jakra lambai l ka taar ek loop mein jhoolta hai (thos aur dashed curves), Single loop, dono siron par node N aur beech mein antinode A; neeche l = lambda1/2.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.7(a): Vibration ka pehla mode (kitab ki Figure 7.7(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

(b) String ko chauthai lambai se chhedna

Agar wohi string apni lambai ke ek chauthai (quarter) hisse se chhedi jaye to phir stationary waves banti hain, jin ke nodes aur antinodes Fig. 7.7 (b) mein hain. Ab string do loops mein vibrate karti hai. Yeh soorat is liye banti hai ke string ko antinode wali jagah se chheda gaya. Do lagataar nodes ka faasla aadhi wavelength hai, is liye string ki lambai l is mode ki wavelength ke barabar hai. Agar in waves ki wavelength λ₂ ho to:

blocks.alt: Wohi jakra taar do loops mein jhoolta hai, Double loop: dono siron aur beech mein node N, har loop mein antinode A; neeche l = lambda2 = 2(lambda2/2).
blocks.caption: Figure 7.7(b): Vibration ka doosra mode (kitab ki Figure 7.7(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Do lagataar nodes ka faasla aadhi wavelength hai. Ek loop mein l = λ₁/2; do loops mein l = 2(λ₂/2) = λ₂. Speed v dono mein barabar hai, is liye doosre mode ki frequency pehle ki double hai: f₂ = 2f₁.

λ₂ = l ko λ₁ = 2l (Eq. 7.2) se milayein to pata chalta hai ke is soorat mein wavelength pehli soorat ki aadhi hai. Eq. (7.3) batati hai ke waves ki speed string ke tension aur fi unit lambai mass par depend karti hai, chhedne ki jagah par nahi. Is liye dono sooraton mein speed v barabar rehti hai.

(7.2)” likhti hai; speed wali equation v = √(F/m) asal mein Eq. (7.3) hai.

(c) String ko kisi bhi point se chhedna

Maan lein string n loops mein resonate karti hai (zor se vibrate karti hai), jin mein (n + 1) nodes aur n antinodes hain. To n loops mein vibrate karti string par banne wali stationary waves ki frequency yeh hogi:
Aur us ki wavelength yeh hogi:
jahan n = 1, 2, 3, ….

Saaf hai ke jitne zyada loops mein string vibrate kare, us ki frequency f utni barhti jati hai aur wavelength λ utni chhoti hoti jati hai. Lekin frequency f aur wavelength λ ka product (zarb) hamesha v, yaani waves ki speed, ke barabar rehta hai.
Upar ki baat se yeh nataij nikalte hain:

items: Stationary waves ki frequencies ka ek alag alag (discrete) set hota hai: f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁, …, nf₁; ise harmonic series kehte hain. Sab se kam frequency fundamental frequency f₁ hai, jo first harmonic hai. Frequency f₂ = 2f₁ second harmonic hai, waghaira.

Doosre lafzon mein resonance frequencies ke darmiyan frequency seedhi chhalang (quantum jump) se badalti hai; is ko Quantization of Frequencies kehte hain: fₙ = nf₁, jahan n = 1, 2, 3, … (poore numbers). String par stationary waves sirf harmonic series ki un frequencies par banti hain jo string ke tension, lambai aur fi unit lambai mass se tay hoti hain. Jo waves harmonic series mein na hon woh jaldi damp ho jati hain (khatam ho jati hain).

Musical instrument ki string ki frequency tension badal kar ya lambai badal kar badli ja sakti hai. Misal: guitar aur violin ki strings ka tension instrument ki gardan (neck) par lagi pegs (khoontiyan) kas kar badla jata hai. Tune karne ke baad musician gardan par ungliyan chala kar string ke vibrate karne wale hisse ki lambai badalte hain, aur is tarah frequency badalti hai.

blocks.text: Harmonics

Upar ki misal mein tamam mumkin standing waves, jin ki frequencies f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁, …, nf₁ hain, system ke harmonics kehlati hain. Sab se kam (fundamental) frequency ko fundamental ya first harmonic kehte hain. Us ke baad wali frequencies second harmonic, third harmonic, waghaira kehlati hain.

blocks.title: Example 7.3
blocks.problem: 120 cm lambi string, jo dono siron se bandhi hai, mein stationary wave bani hai. String 120 Hz frequency par chaar segments (hisson/loops) mein vibrate karti hai. Us ki wavelength aur fundamental frequency nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: l = 120 cm = 120/100 m = 1.2 m, n = 4, f₄ = 120 Hz; f₁ = ?, λ = ?
(i) String chaar segments mein hai aur do lagataar nodes ka faasla λ/2 hai, is liye l = n (λₙ/2), yani λₙ = 2l/n = (2 × 1.2)/4 = 0.6 m.
(ii) n loops mein frequency fₙ = nf₁ hai: f₄ = 4f₁, yani 120 = 4f₁, to f₁ = 120/4.
blocks.answer: λ₄ = 0.6 m aur fundamental frequency f₁ = 30 Hz.

blocks.prompt: Brain Teaser: guitar ki string ko bilkul beech (centre) se chheda jaye to kaunsa harmonic paida hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Beech se chhedne par wahan antinode banta hai aur dono siron par nodes, yani string ek loop mein vibrate karti hai: yeh fundamental frequency, yani first harmonic, hai (Fig. 7.7 a). Jin harmonics (2nd, 4th, …) mein beech mein node hota hai, woh beech se chhedne par paida nahi hote.

blocks.prompt: Brain Teaser: string par 100 Hz frequency ki stationary wave bani hai. Agar string 2 m lambi ho to kitne nodes aur antinodes banenge?
blocks.explanation: Is ke liye string par wave ki speed v bhi chahiye, jo sawal mein nahi di gayi. Tareeqa: fₙ = n(v/2l) se loops n = 2lf/v = (2 × 2 × 100)/v = 400/v. Phir nodes = n + 1 aur antinodes = n. Misal ke taur par agar v = 100 m s⁻¹ ho to n = 4 loops: 5 nodes aur 4 antinodes. Agar v = 200 m s⁻¹ ho to n = 2: 3 nodes aur 2 antinodes.

blocks.prompt: Taar par wave ki speed 24 m s⁻¹ hai; agar us ki lambai 6.0 m ho to kaunsi (sab se kam) driving frequency use resonate karati hai? 0.75 m lambe guitar ke taar ki sab se kam resonance frequency 400 Hz hai; wave speed nikalein. Steel ka taar (diameter 0.50 mm, lambai 1.5 m, density 7.8 × 10³ kg m⁻³) 80 N ka tension sehta hai; us ki fundamental frequency nikalein (numericals 7.1, 7.2, 7.4).

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Jakri hui string ke siron par nodes. Beech se chhedne par ek loop: λ₁ = 2l, v = √(F/m), f₁ = (1/2l) √(F/m).
Chauthai se chhedne par do loops: λ₂ = l, f₂ = 2f₁. n loops: (n + 1) nodes, fₙ = nf₁, λₙ = 2l/n; fλ = v hamesha.
Harmonic series f₁, 2f₁, 3f₁, …; frequencies ki quantization; tension (pegs) ya lambai (ungliyan) se tuning.
